app.title: Catia Toolbox
app.description: CATIA toolbox: nomenclature, comparison, conversion, and Composer processing.

identification.title: 1 - Identification
identification.sub: Read the nomenclature (.xlsm) and input data (.zip) to identify the CATParts to process.

import.title: Import
import.sub: Scan a local folder or import a CSV / JSON listing.

diff.sub: Detect parts added / removed / modified between two imports.

optimizationTree.title: Tree optimization

smgxmlRename.title: 4 - SMGXML: rename
smgxmlRename.sub: Replace the old part name with the new one in the SMGXML (dry-run by default).

settings.title: Settings

picker.folderPlaceholder: Browse or paste a folder path
picker.levelHint: Check files or folders. Click a folder to open it, or list everything recursively.
picker.recursiveHint: Recursive view: all files under this folder. Filter, check, then import.
picker.localHint: No Source root is configured: the file will be copied to the application local storage.
picker.localFolderHint: No Source root is configured: the folder will be copied to the application local storage.

import.title: Import
import.subtitle: Scan a folder or import a listing.
import.metadataNotice: Metadata only (name, size, date). File contents are never read, nothing is written.
import.dropLabel: Drop a CSV or JSON file
import.emptyDesc: Scan a folder or import a listing to start.
import.advancedTitle: Advanced options (scan by path, CSV/JSON listing)
import.nothingSelected: Check at least one file or folder.
import.zipDesc: Imports a whole folder delivered as a .zip archive (contents listed, nothing extracted). Becomes a convertible Source.

tree.noImportDesc: Select or create an import in the Import tab.

treeOptimization.absolutePathPlaceholder: Absolute path to the Composer folder
treeOptimization.noInputRootHint: No Input root configured: browse local folders or paste an absolute path. No files are uploaded.
treeOptimization.invalidFolderContents: The work folder must contain only .smgGeom and .smgXml files, with no subfolders or other files.

browse.title: Browse OneDrive (input)
browse.noRootDesc: Set the input root in the Settings tab.

diff.title: Compare
diff.subtitle: Detect parts added / removed / modified between two imports.
diff.needTwoDesc: Create at least two imports in the Import tab to compare.
diff.nomenNeedTwoDesc: Analyze at least two nomenclatures in the Identification tab to compare them.
diff.versionLimit: Select 2 to {{count}} nomenclatures. With two versions, the historical comparison is preserved.
diff.modeChronology: Chronology: each version against the previous one
diff.modeReference: Reference: every version against one baseline
diff.matrixHint: Each row represents a SIN; cells show its OLD P/N in each version.

conversion.title: CATIA 3D → Composer conversion
conversion.subtitle: Conversion plan (dry-run).
conversion.dryRun: Generates a mapping + a reviewable Python (win32com) script driving Composer (DRY_RUN by default). No conversion is run by the app.
conversion.sourceRequired: Import a folder or a .zip above.
conversion.outputInfo: Flat output: SMGXML + SMGG at the root, the rest moved to "_autres/". Non-destructive: nothing is deleted, your source files are never modified.
conversion.execHint: Runs the script on this PC. "Test" simulates (dry-run, does not call Composer). "Run" drives Composer for real (Composer + pywin32 required). Non-destructive: creates output files, never touches sources.
conversion.composerExecutableHint: Leave blank to detect the CATIA Composer installation automatically.
conversion.composerSettingsHint: Profile saved from CATIA Composer Converter; it defines import options and the output format.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Working folders and CATIA Composer configuration.
settings.deleteUserDataHint: Deletes saved imports, analyses, results, and temporary local copies. OneDrive sources and all application settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
settings.composerHint: License server for your Composer installation (DSLICSRV / DS_LICENSE_SERVER / LSERVRC).

identification.monoAwaitingRun: Mono-body results can be linked after the nomenclature is analyzed.
identification.previewHint: Load the preview, then configure the mapping to enable analysis.

identification.noSinDuplicates: No duplicate SINs in this nomenclature.

identification.monoNoTarget: No nomenclature selected; these results will remain standalone.

identification.monoNotApplied: Mono-body analysis has not yet been applied to this nomenclature.

identification.monoDoneApplied: {{mono}} mono-body part(s) out of {{matched}} matched (applied to parts).

smgxmlRename.title: Rename parts in the SMGXML

smgxmlRename.mappingRequired: Add at least one old=new mapping.
smgxmlRename.composerRoot: COMPOSER root (contains COMP PROD and COMP PART)
smgxmlRename.batchRequired: Pick both folders and a nomenclature.

colorization.required: Run optimization to create the work folder, then select a Mono-Body nomenclature and profiles folder.
